facts.business: Smartlink Holdings Limited is an Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) and Original Design Manufacturer (ODM) operating a certified facility in Goa, producing networking products, EV chargers, and defence electronics, while its subsidiary Digisol Systems Limited sells branded IT networking products.
key_risks: Shortages of critical chipsets and electronic components
facts.related_party_note: Trade receivables include INR 2,585.01 lakhs from Digisol Systems Limited (wholly owned subsidiary) as at March 31, 2026. Mutual Funds pledged against overdraft facility obtained by Digisol Systems Limited. Equity shares pledged against loan obtained by Digisol Systems Limited.
